'''Mushy peas''' is a popular and characteristic British dish that has helped to give British cooking its well-deserved reputation. Mushy peas are often served with [[Cookbook:Fish and Chips|fish and chips]].

==Ingredients==
*Dried [[Cookbook:Marrowfat peas|marrowfat peas]]
*[[Cookbook:Water|Water]]
*2 [[Cookbook:tsp|tsp]] [[Cookbook:Baking Soda|baking soda]]
*1 tsp [[Cookbook:Sugar|sugar]] (optional, to taste)

==Procedure==
#Place the peas in 2–3 times their volume of water, along with the baking soda, which speeds the soaking process.
#Leave to soak overnight.
#The next day, drain the peas, and place in a [[Cookbook:Saucepan|saucepan]] with enough water to just cover them.
#Add the sugar.
#Bring to the [[Cookbook:Boiling|boil]] and [[Cookbook:Simmering|simmer]] for about 20 minutes, stirring occasionally to help break up the peas.
#Add water or reduce to the desired consistency.
#Season to taste with salt and pepper.
